evals.name: audit-study-html
assertions: Establishes or asks what the decks are for before rating the fixed 1/2/3-day intervals
Judges the intervals conditionally on the goal (exam prep vs lifelong retention), not by 'it isn't real SM-2'
Credits Mute, undo, per-direction schedules and Cycle mode as strengths
Flags permanent 'Mastered' retirement and the missing 'forgot' grade with concrete fixes
Uses Strong/Partial/Missing/Conflicts/N/A ratings with file:line evidence
Does not modify study.html

evals.name: design-piaano-scheduler
evals.prompt: Use dojo to design step 3 of Piaano's Pattern Trainer (the scheduler). Project: C:\Users\James\Documents\Piaano\piaano
assertions: Reads HANDOFF.md / docs/pattern-trainer.md and respects recorded decisions without re-arguing them
Applies S12: chord shapes are the skill, so a fixed repeated pool (Woodpecker-style) plus spaced return
Applies the accuracy gate (T1/S9) and the learning-vs-performance split (T2)
Keeps other variables steady while introducing new chord families (S10)
Output is design notes with principle IDs, not code

evals.name: lens-streak-feature
evals.prompt: Piaano has 'Dojo lens: on' in HANDOFF.md. Feature request: add a daily streak counter on the home screen that resets to 0 if a day is missed. Write the implementation plan only (don't edit files).
assertions: Plans the feature as asked (does not refuse or block)
Adds a short 'Dojo lens' note (about 5 lines or fewer) flagging the punishing reset (A1/A2) with a small alternative
Does not lecture or produce a full audit

evals.name: coach-session
evals.prompt: Teach me the basics of musical intervals.
assertions: Coach mode, session-only: brief concrete explanation tied to something known
Asks the learner to produce something (identify/explain/predict) before giving more
No theory dump; no deadlines; neutral tone
Does not create a long-running subject folder unasked

evals.name: no-trigger-ordinary-question
evals.prompt: What's the difference between a major and minor third?
assertions: The dojo skill is not triggered: a plain answer, no quiz, no offer to make cards or drills

evals.name: cards-from-notes
evals.prompt: Make flashcards from these notes for my study app: The spacing effect: spreading reviews out beats cramming. The testing effect: recalling information strengthens memory more than rereading. Desirable difficulty (Bjork): effortful retrieval increases storage strength. Interleaving: mixing topics improves discrimination.
assertions: Produces a 2-column, headerless CSV that passes cards_csv.py validation
Cards are atomic recall prompts (not true/false), one fact each
Row 1 does not trip the question/answer header quirk
